items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday; expected to play after hip injury.
items.why: Hip; no designation, returns vs Eagles. Speculation on possible snap limits.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Rams offense and fantasy WR1/2 value; monitor volume.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets return, though limited snaps possible early.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; good to go returning from hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring recovery; confirmed active/good to go vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Elite WR return in favorable DvP; Texans scoring boost expected.
items.opportunity: Full target share likely in high-implied total spot.

items.text: Breece Hall among players out for Sunday.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts; handcuff/backup volume spike.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snaps for remaining Jets RBs.

items.implication: Commanders QB change; Mariota or backup likely, impacts all pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Potential game-script shift to more run or different pass volume.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Eagles passing game depleted alongside Goedert and Baun absences.
items.opportunity: Higher target share potential for remaining Eagles skill players.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle; final injury report confirmation.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Minnesota offense; boosts other Vikings pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs especially Addison.

items.text: Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson OUT creates clear path to elevated targets/routes in good matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with expanded opportunity.
items.opportunity: Target share spike, red-zone potential vs soft secondary.

items.implication: Miami backfield fully reshaped for ROS; handcuffs elevated permanently.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for remaining Dolphins RBs.

items.text: Dallas Goedert listed OUT along with Smith and Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.why: Injury; confirmed in Sunday list with key Eagles absences.
items.implication: Eagles TE vacuum and overall skill depletion vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Possible TE2 or WR target bump internally.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough early run: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass work to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet back at practice; listed OUT. Still passes eye test long-term.
items.why: Chest injury plus role erosion and Charbonnet practicing; ETR lists OUT with Charbonnet.
items.implication: Seahawks RB depth chart fluid; short-term sit, long-term hold if rosterable.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.implication: Full dual-threat QB1 locked in; Ravens offense stabilized.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; top-10 play vs CLE allowing 88+ rush yds every game.
items.why: Workhorse role locked with Dowdle out; elite snap/touch share vs weak run D.
items.opportunity: Near-full snaps, carries, and receiving work.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love on LOVE list: 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined), RB5 utilization, double-digit target share every game; Giants allow 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Exploding usage and efficiency in favorable matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB start/flex with high touch volume.

items.text: Omarion Hampton on HATE list: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3, only 13% third-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Declining role/usage + tough run defense matchup.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats this week.
